name: Bulette Bulwark
body:
Source Dungeon Denizens Revisited pg. 7
Aura faint abjuration CL 9th
Slot shield; Price 9,157 gp; Weight 15 lbs.
Description
Fashioned from a bulette’s neck armor, this +3 heavy shield is as hard as steel (hardness 10, 20 hp). Because it is not made of metal, druids can use it without penalty.
Construction
Requirements Craft Magic Arms and Armor, 1 intact set of neck plates from a bulette; Price 4,657 gp, 360 XP
